title: "Career Readiness"
subtitle: "25% of course grade · 250 points"
---

Career Readiness assignments cover what it means to be a physicist and explore opportunities for physicists at the undergraduate, graduate, and career levels. Assignments are announced in class and posted here as they are assigned.

Unless a deliverable says otherwise, submit your work to Canvas as a **PDF** by **11:59 PM ET** on the due date. Late work is not accepted.

## Deliverables

| Deliverable | Due | Points | |
|---|---|---|---|
| Résumé | Sept. 11, 11:59 PM ET | 100 | [Open assignment](deliverables/resume.qmd) |
| Additional deliverables (TBD) | TBD | 150 | — |
| **Total** | | **250** | |
